tombstone: The Peach Blossom Spring (桃花源圖), 1650. Liu Du (Chinese, active c. 1628-after 1653). Hanging scroll; ink and light color on satin; painting: 135.8 x 52 cm (53 7/16 x 20 1/2 in.); overall with knobs: 241.5 x 79 cm (95 1/16 x 31 1/8 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, John L. Severance Fund, 1971.227
title: The Peach Blossom Spring

inscriptions.inscription:
Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals at middle right edge: 

In the tenth month of the gengyin year [1650], painted in imitation of Zhao Chengzhi [Chao Mengfu].  Liu Du [seals] Liu Du zhi yin; Shu xian.
2 additional seals of Low Chuck Tiew 劉作籌 (1911–1993).
